noCalendar.title: You have no calendar yet
noCalendar.body: Only coaches with a calendar can be booked. Pick a coach's calendar in the menu, or ask the owner to add yours.

loadError: This didn't load. Check your connection and try again.

errors.slot_taken: That time was just taken. Pick another one.
errors.not_active: This booking is no longer active. Reload to see its status.
errors.not_started: You can mark it once the booking has started.

health.title: Health questionnaire
health.flagged: At least one question was answered yes. Read the answers before the test.
health.hidden: Only the coach of this booking sees the answers.

cancel.title: Cancel this booking?
cancel.body: {name} gets an email that the booking is cancelled, with a link to book a new time.

reschedule.title: Move this booking
reschedule.body: Pick a free time. {name} gets an email with the new time and an updated calendar invite.

settings.availabilityBody: Your weekly hours, holidays and extra days. Customers can book only inside them.

availability.title: Availability
availability.lead: When customers can book you. Times are Ljubljana time.
availability.weekBody: Every week repeats these hours. A day without hours can't be booked.
availability.exceptionsBody: Close days you're away, or open hours on a day you normally don't work. Pick a day or a range in the calendar.
availability.pickDays: Pick a day or a range in the calendar.
